description: List PostgreSQL community contributors aggregated across git trailers (Reviewed-by, Tested-by, etc.), commit author/committer headers, and buildfarm animal owners. Sorted by total contributions descending. Filterable by release / role / source.

release.description: Restrict to one release, e.g. PG18 / PG17 / pre-9.6; 17, pg17, REL_17 and REL_17_STABLE mean PG17

role.description: Restrict to one role: authored, reviewed, tested, reported, committed, co-authored, suggested, signed-off, buildfarm-owner, ...

source.description: Restrict to one source: git, buildfarm, email, wiki, commitfest

name: list_contributors
